```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 05_z_scores_scores_means
title: >
  Describe the Scores Again
questions:
  - id: mean_comparison
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      Suppose the mean completion times are 10 seconds for the easy test and 100
      seconds for the hard test. How do your times of 8 and 70 seconds compare with
      their respective means?
    answer: >
      Both are faster than average. The easy-test time is 2 seconds below its mean,
      and the hard-test time is 30 seconds below its mean.
    explanation: >
      The raw deviations have different units of comparison until we know how much
      completion times vary on each test.
```
